html:
EA SPORTS FC™ 25 SHOWCASE is a preview of EA SPORTS FC 25 - offering a taste of what’s new in The World’s Game. EA SPORTS FC 25 SHOWCASE contains a rotating selection of content, features and modes (“Content”) from Learn to Play, Kick-Off with select clubs and Clubs Rush with limited progression. Practice the basics in Learn to Play, play with a selection of top football teams in Kick-Off or create your own player and enjoy the thrill of 5-a-side football with the all-new Rush gameplay in Clubs, teaming up with friends.

Content is not available at all times and in all territories and is subject to change. Gameplay progress will be removed once Content is removed or SHOWCASE is retired. EA may retire SHOWCASE in its entirety after 30 days notice at ea.com/service-updates.

Upgrade to the full EA SPORTS FC 25 experience with the same EA Account on the same platform before SHOWCASE retires to continue your Pro’s progression in Clubs, gain access to every corner of The World’s Game from Manager and Player Career to Football Ultimate Team, and unlock all 19,000+ players from 700+ authentic clubs that make FC 25 the most true-to-football experience available.
